Literal Markdown punctuation is escaped while converted emphasis and code stay formatted

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.scrape("{\"content\":{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_misc\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", "https://example.com");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
